description: Foundation: generalize the crypto primitives, the PIN-gated reveal server action, the dedicated DL write action, and the reusable secret display/edit client components so they work for ssn, driversLicense, safetyCouncil, and twic. Independent of the grid-redesign (FEAT-003) and dark-theme (FEAT-004) features; FEAT-002 depends on this one.
steps: src/lib/crypto.ts: add maskLast4(decrypted: string | null): string holding the current masking body; make maskSsn delegate to it (keep maskSsn exported, behavior unchanged). Add encField(value: string | null | undefined): string | null that mirrors encSsn (trim, empty/whitespace -> null, else encryptSecret) and whose FIRST line is the FIX5 idempotency guard: if (typeof value === 'string' && isEncrypted(value)) return value;. Optionally reimplement encSsn as a thin wrapper over encField. Do NOT touch encryptSecret/decryptSecret/isEncrypted/safeDecrypt.

src/app/admin/pin/actions.ts: define and export type SecretFieldKey = 'ssn' | 'driversLicense' | 'safetyCouncil' | 'twic'. Add revealField(pin: string, employeeId: string, field: SecretFieldKey) returning the same union as revealSsn but with {ok:true; value:string}. Reproduce revealSsn's 3-part additive gate (per-field canView AND canFullView AND non-admin site restriction) and HARD decryptSecret -> catch -> DECRYPT_FAILED. Map field -> {column, viewKey}: ssn->{ssn,'ssn'}, driversLicense->{driversLicenseNumber,'driverLicense'}, safetyCouncil->{safetyCouncilId,'safetyExpiry'}, twic->{twicNumber,'twicExpiry'}. FIX2: build the prisma select as a `satisfies Prisma.EmployeeSelect` object including the needed column plus site/projectLeadEmail/projectManagerEmail/createdById, and read the value via a direct e[column] access — do NOT use `select: { [column]: true } as const`. Keep revealSsn as a wrapper delegating to revealField(pin, employeeId, 'ssn') (adapt its {ok:true; ssn} shape by mapping value->ssn so existing callers compile) OR update its two callers (SsnField, SsnEditCell) to the new signature in the next steps.

src/app/admin/actions.ts: add setEmployeeDriversLicense(formData: FormData): Promise<GatedResult> byte-for-byte identical to setEmployeeSsn with ssn->driverLicense: requireColumn('driverLicense','edit',id) in try/catch -> {ok:false,error:'Not authorized'}, checkPin, empty-save-no-op ({ok:true}), explicit clear -> data {driversLicenseNumber: null}, else data {driversLicenseNumber: encField(value)}, revalidatePath('/admin/grid'), return {ok:true}. Import encField from @/lib/crypto. Leave the setEmployeeField 'driverLicense' case in place but treat the dedicated action as the single authoritative grid write path.

src/app/admin/SsnField.tsx -> generalize to a reusable component SecretField({ maskedValue, employeeId, field, label, canReveal }: { maskedValue: string; employeeId: string; field: SecretFieldKey; label: string; canReveal: boolean }). Keep SSN visual behavior. Call revealField(pin, employeeId, field) in onConfirm. FIX4: render the eye button ONLY when canReveal is true; aria-label/title read 'Reveal <label>'/'Hide <label>'. Add a comment: both grid table+card instances are mounted (CSS-hidden); per-instance reveal state is safe ONLY because this component has NO mount-time side effect (no autofocus/auto-open) — keep it that way. Export SecretField (default or named consistently with how callers import). If other current callers still import SsnField, add a compatibility wrapper or update them.

src/app/admin/grid/SsnEditCell.tsx -> generalize to SecretEditCell({ employeeId, maskedValue, field, canReveal, label }). Reveal via revealField. FIX3: dispatch save/clear by field via explicit lookup const WRITE_ACTION: Partial<Record<SecretFieldKey,(fd:FormData)=>Promise<GatedResult>>> = { ssn: setEmployeeSsn, driversLicense: setEmployeeDriversLicense }; use WRITE_ACTION[field] for the save/clear FormData submit — a DL save must never go through the SSN column. Keep empty-save-no-op + explicit-clear-null. Render the eye only when canReveal. Keep PinDialog usage; title/description reference the label.

Update the two existing SSN usages so the project still compiles with the generalized components: src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx and src/app/admin/employee/[id]/page.tsx currently import SsnField/SsnEditCell. If you renamed the exports, either (a) keep thin SsnField/SsnEditCell re-export shims so FEAT-001 leaves a buildable tree, or (b) update those two call sites now to SecretField/SecretEditCell with field='ssn', label='SSN', canReveal={canView(access,'ssn')} / show('ssn'). Prefer (a) shims if you do not want to touch the pages until FEAT-002, so FEAT-001 ends green.
acceptance_criteria: crypto.ts exports maskLast4 and encField; maskSsn still returns the same values as before for the same inputs; encField returns its input unchanged when the input is already enc:v1: (idempotent).

pin/actions.ts exports revealField and SecretFieldKey; revealField applies the identical 3-part gate and HARD-decrypts with DECRYPT_FAILED on failure; the column is read via a satisfies Prisma.EmployeeSelect select, not a computed-key `as const` select.
actions.ts exports setEmployeeDriversLicense that writes { driversLicenseNumber: encField(value) } (or null on clear) and never touches the ssn column.
SecretField and SecretEditCell accept { field, label, canReveal } and render the eye only when canReveal is true; neither receives ciphertext.
The whole worktree still type-checks and builds.
verification: From c:\Sir project\ontask\.worktrees\security-pin run: npx tsc --noEmit  (expect zero errors)
From the same dir run: npm run build  (expect exit 0)
findings:
DONE. Verification green: `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors, `npm run build` exit 0.

Crypto (src/lib/crypto.ts): new exports maskLast4(decrypted) and encField(value). maskSsn now delegates to maskLast4 (values unchanged); encSsn is now a thin wrapper over encField. encField's FIRST line is the FIX5 idempotency guard `if (typeof value === 'string' && isEncrypted(value)) return value;` so an already-`enc:v1:` value passes through unchanged (never double-encrypted). Later FEATs: use encField for driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber writes, and maskLast4 (or maskSsn) for the invoices CSV DL case.

Reveal (src/app/admin/pin/actions.ts): new exports `type SecretFieldKey = 'ssn'|'driversLicense'|'safetyCouncil'|'twic'` and revealField(pin, employeeId, field): Promise<{ok:true;value:string} | {ok:false;code;error}>. Internal FIELD_MAP: ssn->{ssn,'ssn'}, driversLicense->{driversLicenseNumber,'driverLicense'}, safetyCouncil->{safetyCouncilId,'safetyExpiry'}, twic->{twicNumber,'twicExpiry'}. Reproduces the identical 3-part additive gate (per-field canView AND canFullView AND non-admin site restriction) and HARD decryptSecret->catch->DECRYPT_FAILED. revealSsn is now a wrapper over revealField(...,'ssn') mapping value->ssn, so SsnField/SsnEditCell callers compiled unchanged.

FIX2 NOTE for later FEATs: a computed-key select `{ [column]: true } satisfies Prisma.EmployeeSelect` compiles for the SELECT object but WIDENS the findUnique RESULT type (TS can't narrow a variable key), so e[column] and e.site/e.projectLeadEmail become a union of ALL Employee fields and fail. Resolved by selecting all four secret columns plus the row-scope fields with LITERAL keys (satisfies Prisma.EmployeeSelect), then reading e[column] directly (no cast). Follow this literal-key pattern wherever a dynamic column read is needed.

Write action (src/app/admin/actions.ts): new export setEmployeeDriversLicense(formData): Promise<GatedResult>, byte-for-byte setEmployeeSsn with ssn->driverLicense: requireColumn('driverLicense','edit',id) in try/catch, checkPin, empty-save-no-op, explicit clear -> {driversLicenseNumber:null}, else {driversLicenseNumber: encField(value)}, revalidatePath('/admin/grid'). encField imported from @/lib/crypto. The setEmployeeField 'driverLicense' case is left intact but the dedicated action is the authoritative grid DL write path.

Components: SsnField -> generalized to src/app/admin/SecretField.tsx (default export) with props { maskedValue, employeeId, field, label, canReveal }; calls revealField; FIX4 eye renders ONLY when canReveal; aria-label/title 'Reveal <label>'/'Hide <label>'; documented mount-side-effect-free comment (grid mounts table+card instances CSS-hidden). SsnEditCell -> generalized to src/app/admin/grid/SecretEditCell.tsx (default export) with props { employeeId, maskedValue, field, canReveal, label }; FIX3 WRITE_ACTION = { ssn: setEmployeeSsn, driversLicense: setEmployeeDriversLicense } dispatch (a DL save never goes through the SSN column); eye only when canReveal; empty-save-no-op + explicit-clear-null preserved.

SHIMS (Rule 7 option a): src/app/admin/SsnField.tsx and src/app/admin/grid/SsnEditCell.tsx are now THIN re-export shims (SSN, label 'SSN', canReveal) delegating to the generalized components, so grid/page.tsx and employee/[id]/page.tsx compile UNCHANGED. FEAT-002 should migrate those two call sites to SecretField/SecretEditCell directly (field/label/canReveal from canView(access,...)/show(...)) and can then delete the shims.
